title: MCP server over the public API
description: Parked earlier; now built as plantool mcp (stdio, stages 1 and 2 of the plan agreed on 2026-11-14). Agents without a shell use the same operations as the CLI for reading, claiming, finishing and noting. Decisions a person owns cannot be made through it. See docs/implementation-decisions.md (MCP server).
why: Agents without a shell need the same operations; listed as planned in the onboarding briefing.
risks: HTTP and MCP callers could decide as a person

outcome.summary: plantool mcp: stdio server with 21 tools (stages 1 and 2); agent name from the server; person decisions refused.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test 116 pass (6 MCP tests); stdio smoke test in a throwaway project; pnpm run check.
